acquisitionProvenanceBinding.semantics: Every future acquisition instant is recorded only in a DatasetSnapshotRecord/1 body pinned beside the raw object it describes. No acquisition instant is ever inferred from file mtime, from the ingestion clock or from any field outside that record.

fields.sourceAcquiredAt: UTC instant at which the provider bytes were obtained, or null while no acquisition has occurred. Null is the only admissible value under the current authority.
fields.acquisitionMethod: Identifier of the mechanism that produced the raw bytes. LOCAL_PINNED_BYTES_NO_ACQUISITION is the only value reachable without a distinct later Owner fetch authority.
fields.acquisitionToolVersion: Version identifier of the tool that performed the acquisition, defaulting to the persistence surface version when the bytes were supplied locally.
fields.acquisitionRequestIdentity: Structured identity of the request that obtained the bytes, including the governing authority identifier and whether network was authorized.
fields.acquisitionEvidenceIds: Sorted, de-duplicated sha256 content addresses of acquisition evidence objects. Empty while nothing has been acquired.

immutability.supersessionRule: A new manifest is published under a new content address; no previously published manifest, raw object or normalized object is ever rewritten.

resumeSemantics.crashSafety: The raw object is durably written and re-verified in the content-addressed store before the journal advances to RAW_PINNED, so a crash between the two loses the journal entry and never the bytes.
resumeSemantics.zeroRefetch: Once an acquisition key is RAW_PINNED no acquirer is consulted for it again; every later stage re-reads the pinned bytes out of the store.

retrospectiveSemanticsRationale: The historical plane reconstructs prior sessions from bytes pinned at a single later acquisition instant. It does not reproduce what a consumer could have observed at each historical session, so no vintage claim is made for any date before sourceAcquiredAt.
